messages:
jules: FYI I opened a docs PR to tighten SOC2 wording and update SDK snippets for the retention playbook. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3899. Can folks sanity-check wording + example payloads (no PII) before merge?

docs-bot: PR created: jules/retention-playbook-sdk-update (#3899). CI queued.

meera: Quick scan: avoid 'we automatically purge' phrasing. Prefer 'records are retained for up to 90 days unless contractually required otherwise or subject to legal hold.'

legal-ops: Agreed. Also add a short sentence clarifying that retention windows may vary by product tier and contractual terms, and that legal holds override standard retention.

dan: SDK snippets use `RetentionClient.delete_after(days=90)` which is a dangerous exemplar. Replace with a read-only example showing `RetentionClient.get_window()` and a separate example demonstrating setting policies via the Admin API with explicit consent.

meera: For examples, redact any emails/IDs. Use placeholders like `user_id: "cust-xxxxx"` and `kms_key: "arn:aws:kms:REGION:ACCOUNT:key/KEYID"`. Don't include real ARNs.

infra-bot: Note: export CLI flag changed in latest runtime: `--retention-window` is now `--retention-policy`. If docs include CLI, update flag name and add a version note.

jules: Good catch infra-bot. I'll update CLI flags and add a small "Changes in 2026.1" note.

legal-ops: Also include a short checklist for auditors: format of exported evidence (JSONL), fields that may contain PII, how customers can request extended retention via contract, and a note on CMKs: "When using a customer-managed key (CMK), ensure the KMS key policy permits export decryption."

dan: Add a Troubleshooting bullet for the common error `retention: permission denied` suggesting to check the `retention.admin` role and KMS decrypt permissions.

jules: Will implement all edits and push. Tagging @legal-ops for final review after CI.

docs-bot: CI passed for #3899. Linter OK.

legal-ops: Reviewed and approved. You can merge once release checklist is green.

jules: Merged. Thanks everyone!
